products.title: Wilson Blade V4 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

products.title: Nox Start Black Ex Js 2026 - Nox
products.description:
NOX START BLACK EX JS 2026 - The most recommended Nox padel racket to progress. A great value for money model with a modern design for the 2026/2027 season. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The NOX START BLACK EX JS 2026 joins the new collection of Nox rackets for the 2026 season. Round format model, a very peculiar new format that provides high control and a very wide sweet spot.

PLAYER TYPE

We find it to be a particularly interesting racket for players who are starting to play frequently and want to take a step forward compared to the most basic rackets.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The round format chosen for it, as we have mentioned, favors a wide sweet spot and makes it forgive us quite well when we do not hit exactly in the center.

Quality materials, such as an HR3 Soft eva rubber in its core, one of Nox's most comfortable rubbers, designed for total control and great vibration reduction.

The planes are made of FG 3K fiberglass, a more elastic material than carbon that provides a pleasant hit.

products.title: Black Crown Win Ultralight 2025 - Black Crown
products.description:
BLACK CROWN WIN ULTRALIGHT 2025 - A super light control racket, for people who lack sufficient strength or technique, with a weight between 270 and 300 grams. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The Black Crown Win Ultralight 2025 is a racket with a sober and elegant aesthetic, with a black background and red details. Made with good materials from the brand that offers its guarantee in a product specially designed for a children's market or for people who require a very light racket to learn the technique of hitting.

PLAYER TYPE

The type of player for whom this racket is indicated is a low/initiation level since its composition and shape make it special for excellent maneuverability and ball control, so necessary for beginners.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The Win Ultralight is made with a 100% carbon frame, giving it good resistance and robustness. The shape of the blade is round, to offer maximum control and sweet spot of impacts. On its faces we have two sheets of fiberglass and an ultra-light sheet of fiberglass. 

PLAY STYLE

Due to its surprising weight, this racket will make a difference for those who cannot learn good technique in their beginnings due to not being able to handle with sufficient ease in their classes. Being round and with fiberglass faces, it is very comfortable to touch and balance. A safe bet for those starting out.

products.title: Head Motion Pro Padel Men Bbfc 39 - Head
products.description:
HEAD MOTION PRO PADEL MEN BBFC - Some more striking padel shoes, combining navy blue and red. High-end professional, with a very grippy sole. INTRODUCTION OF THE SNEAKERS

The HEAD MOTION PRO PADEL MEN BBFC are the high-end Head shoes for the 2024 season. This new Motion Range has several models, and these are the top ones. Designed with a beautiful combination of navy and red tones.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for competitive players. They are not basic sneakers. If we want to take advantage of it, we will have to be demanding, play and compete.

MOST IMPORTANT CONSTRUCTION DATA

These Head padel shoes are a model that incorporates innovative technologies. For these models they add a new type of sole with a unique pattern. It is similar to clay.

For greater comfort, it incorporates Dynafoam technology, air cells that absorb vibrations and improve the sensations underfoot.

Made with breathable mesh fabric almost throughout the entire shoe, except in the most delicate areas that have several reinforcements. This mesh fabric improves flexibility and comfort when we use them.
